builtFor.label: Built for
builtFor.title: Right-wing parties, campaigns and political groups.

audience.title: Party headquarters
audience.body: Strategy and data offices planning national and regional campaigns.

audience.title: Campaign teams
audience.body: Managers deciding where to send candidates, volunteers and budget.

audience.title: Elected officials
audience.body: Representatives and their staff, following their territory between elections.

audience.title: Foundations and think tanks
audience.body: Research teams that need historical results they can cite.

builtFor.principle: Territorial analysis uses public, aggregate data only: no voter files, no individual profiles. We analyse places, not people.

polis.purpose: Electoral intelligence for national and regional campaigns.

features.title: Constituency dashboard
features.body: All 147 single-member constituencies, projected from the 2022 results onto current polls.

features.title: Electoral history
features.body: General and European election results since 1946 for 7,906 municipalities, with ISTAT data.

features.title: Territorial priorities
features.body: Municipalities ranked by how contested they are, how much turnout can be recovered and how large their population is.

features.title: Media monitoring
features.body: Regional and local news in one feed, with AI summaries checked against the source articles, and a YouTube monitor.

features.title: Climate and trends
features.body: Polls compared with the 2022 result, leader ratings by pollster, the issues in the news and ISTAT indicators.

features.title: Scenarios
features.body: Build coalitions and simulate seats under the current electoral law, plus a simulation of the ‘Stabilicum’ reform, labelled as not in force.

features.title: Election calendar
features.body: Past elections and the expected windows for the next ones, always marked as projected.

features.title: Audit and reports
features.body: Checksums for every dataset, validation and AI logs, human approval of new data, and PDF reports that mark what is raw data, calculation or AI.

solo.purpose: Software for election campaigns in cities and municipalities.

features.title: Neighbourhood results
features.body: Results and maps down to each neighbourhood of the city.

features.title: Demographic profile
features.body: The demographic make-up of every district.

features.title: Election-night monitoring
features.body: Live monitoring of local elections as the results come in.

features.title: Built for phones
features.body: Mobile-first, for campaign teams in the field.

solo.alt: Concept screen of Orthanc Solo: municipal results and a map of the city’s wards, with invented data.
solo.caption: Concept screen, not real data.

logos.purpose: A financial engine, fed by Orthanc Polis and Orthanc Solo, that helps a party decide where, how and when to invest.

features.title: Where
features.body: The territories where each euro of campaign budget counts most.

features.title: How
features.body: How to split the budget across territories and activities.

features.title: When
features.body: When to spend across the electoral calendar.

features.title: One source
features.body: Fed directly by the data in Orthanc Polis and Orthanc Solo.
